text:
1998 FIFA World Cup a wɔyɛe wɔ France fi 10 June kɔsi 12 July no yɛɛ nsesaeɛ kɛseɛ wɔ tournament no mu. Ɛyɛ mprɛn a edi kan a wɔtrɛɛ teams no firi 24 kɔ 32, na wɔde too groups awotwe mu a group biara wɔ teams anan. Top two firi group biara kɔɔ single-elimination knockout phase a ɛfiri round of 16 kɔ quarter-finals, semi-finals ne final. Ɛyɛ matches 64 a wɔbɔɔ wɔ stadiums 10 mu, na nnipa 2,785,100 bɛhwɛe, average 43,517 per game. Format a wɔtrɛɛ no maa debutants Croatia, Jamaica, Japan ne South Africa ba, na tournament no de golden goal rule bae wɔ knockout stage no mu.

Hosts no twaa knockout rounds no nyinaa mu, dii match biara a wɔbɔɔ no nyinaa de kɔɔ final wɔ Stade de France wɔ Saint-Denis, ɛnyɛ nkyɛn Paris. Ɛhɔ na wɔhyiaa Brazil, title holders no ne team a wɔsuro wɔn paa wɔ tournament no mu. Match no daa nsesaeɛ adi ansa na wɔrebɔ no: Ronaldo, Brazil star no ne Golden Ball winner a ɔyɛ player a ɔyɛ yie no, hunuu convulsive fit wɔ final no awia mu na wɔde no firii team sheet no mu kakra ansa na wɔde no bae bio. Ɔbɔɔ nanso ɔnnyɛ den, na ɛde controversy a ɛkɔ so nnɛ no bae.

France de Zinedine Zidane dii dwuma no, ɔtoo header mmienu wɔ first-half mu, wɔ 27th minute ne first-half stoppage time (45+1′). Emmanuel Petit too nea ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ stoppage time (90+3′) de 3-0 nkonimdie no siee wɔ regular time mu, na wɔanhia extra time anaa penalties. France yɛɛ champions, Brazil yɛɛ runners-up.

Nkonimdie no maa France yɛɛ ɔman a ɛdi kan a ɛto so nsia a wɔadi World Cup, na ɛyɛ ɔman a ɛto so enum a wɔadi wɔ wɔn ankasa asase so, wɔn title a ɛdi kan. Ɛhɔ nso, Croatia daa ne ho adi denam, kɔɔ semi-finals wɔ World Cup a ɛdi kan a ɔyɛ ɔman a ɛdi ne ho so no mu na ɔdi mprɛnso wɔ ɔman a ɛto so nnan Netherlands so 2-1 wɔ third-place match no mu. Croatia Davor Suker dii tournament no mu top scorer a ɔtoo goals nsia, na ɔgyee Golden Boot no.
